results.name: Intake controls mount inside the existing source workspace with explicit actions and no auto-analysis
Actual explicit analysis reports current source identity and leaves workspace, build, project, history, assembler and emulator intact
Engine declarations are report-only, never added to version 1 workspace or source ZIP exports
Explicit foreign declarations refuse UI assembly; unknown and Forge declarations preserve the existing build path
Successful workspace replacement resets declarations and restores the ordinary example build
Failed replacement preserves source and declarations but retires the previous report
Native text edits, build settings and declaration edits invalidate reports immediately
Analysis completing after source edits, settings, declarations or cancellation cannot install stale reports
Starting either asynchronous import invalidates analysis before any bytes finish loading
Later analysis wins when an older success or failure finishes last
Report Save As exports exact current evidence and cancellation retains a usable report
Report export revalidates declarations even when a programmatic change missed its input event
Stale report-save success, cancellation and failure cannot overwrite newer status or resurrect a report
Busy or failed Save As requests keep the current report and do not claim an export started
Long inventory and dependency displays disclose omitted rows while JSON retains all evidence
Public report return values and state snapshots cannot mutate the owned export evidence
Unsafe-looking source names and metadata render as literal report text
Metadata fields share source keyboard isolation without cancelling native editing
Current analysis errors leave source, active project and earlier source ROM available
